skill:skills/palistor-lists/SKILL.md.reason: Four list behaviours changed in Cube. (1) list.dirty: was 'the membership differs from the loaded one'; now also true when a row owns a nested list that is dirty the same way, at any depth, so the owner row, its list and the form are dirty; a row's field values still take no part; a paginated list counts every cached page (SKILL.md 'Add, remove and confirm rows', references/list-api.md, references/pagination.md 'Local edits'). (2) store.reset(): a loaded nested list or row field keeps its result and the next read requests nothing (was: went idle and fetched again); the reset also reaches nested lists of off-screen owners (SKILL.md 'Edit rows in place', list-api.md 'Lists nested inside a row', entity-editing.md). (3) nextCursor: null ends a cursor / infinite feed and wins over total, hasMore: true and a full page; a missing field keeps the old rule; an offset feed must omit it (references/pagination.md resolver contract, members, mistakes 25-26, infinite example without hasMore). (4) onError gets { notify, t }; inside defineList the strict-TS form is a cast (list-api.md 'Declaring a list'). Also: how a nested list gets its rows (own resolver, add / setItems, initialData; not the outer resolver), and that a usePalistor store starts after the commit (an eager list reads loading: true / resolveStatus 'idle' in the first render). cube/react/usePalistor.ts was added to the skill's sources for that reason. references/filtering.md is unchanged: no filter behaviour changed.

skill:skills/palistor-ssr/SKILL.md.head: fe3820074ac7247388ace7e1c42b1bf3de7d38ab
skill:skills/palistor-ssr/SKILL.md.reason: Stage 5a of experiments/SsrPlan.md changed when a usePalistor store starts. Old guidance: only the server pass starts nothing, and the browser's store starts in its constructor. New: usePalistor builds the store held, an effect calls store.start() after the first commit, a render React throws away requests nothing, server: true in the hook is the manual mode, new Palistor() is unchanged (new section 'Know when the store starts'). The Suspense section gained the browser side: the first render of a suspense: true node shows defaults with loading: true, a reader of the node's own loading (and any list reader) suspends once the store starts, the owning component may read the node itself, a fields-only reader never reaches the fallback on a client mount. 'Hand over what the server fetched': 'reload()' became 'the list's reload()' with the note that a group has no reload/resolveStatus/error; added the exception that only initialData and a restored draft fill nested lists; nextCursor: null in a first page ends the feed; reset() returns to initialData without a request. onError examples now show { notify, t } in strict-TS form (cast inside defineList).
